category.title: Simple category
category.description: Enter a simple business category. Supported examples: informatica, software, consulenza, marketing, alimentare, tessile, edilizia, immobiliare, ristorazione, trasporti, turismo, meccanica.

categories.title: Additional categories
categories.description: Extra categories to merge into the search. Use simple words such as software, alimentare, tessile or edilizia. Leave empty if the main category is enough.

dataDepth.title: Data depth
dataDepth.description: listing = fast listing data only. full = listing plus company detail enrichment such as VAT number, address, postal code and employees.

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Maximum number of companies to save. Use 100-500 for tests. Use thousands for production runs.

maxPagesPerCategory.title: Maximum pages per category
maxPagesPerCategory.description: Safety limit for category pages. Each page usually contains about 25 companies.

includeWebsiteContacts.title: Try website contact enrichment
includeWebsiteContacts.description: If a real company website is found, also inspect it for public emails, PEC and phone numbers. This slows runs down and often returns few results because aziende.it rarely exposes company websites.

listingConcurrency.title: Listing speed
listingConcurrency.description: Parallel requests during the fast listing phase. Recommended: 16-24.

detailConcurrency.title: Detail speed
detailConcurrency.description: Parallel requests during the company detail phase. Recommended: 10-16. Higher values may increase retries/timeouts depending on the source response time.

listingMaxRequestsPerMinute.title: Listing requests per minute
listingMaxRequestsPerMinute.description: Rate limit for listing pages. Recommended: 180-240.

detailMaxRequestsPerMinute.title: Detail requests per minute
detailMaxRequestsPerMinute.description: Rate limit for detail pages. Recommended: 130-170. Increase carefully if retries remain low.

startUrls.title: Advanced category URLs
startUrls.description: Optional. Add specific aziende.it category URLs if you want to bypass the simple presets.

debug.title: Debug HTML
debug.description: Save the first category page HTML into the key-value store for selector debugging.
